title: The prescribed fixed-resolution normalization maps
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X\to S [def-pc-scheme] and abelian sheaf F [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], prescribe an injective resolution I. For an etale chart V of S, let W=V\times _S X and restrict I termwise by exact inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Use the augmentation with the single-complex comparison to regard this as a K-injective resolution. Its derived-sections comparison [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], the localization restriction/sections isomorphism and evaluation of homology identify H^q(W,F|W) with H^q((f_*I)(V)). Construct the cocycle map from the homology presheaf to R^qf_*F [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] by sheafifying homology, applying the sheafification counit, then the two augmentation-normalized classical derived-functor comparisons. Define iota by this map after the sections isomorphism, using the chosen resolution. Transport the homology-presheaf restriction to the chart cohomology groups. Define chart cohomology pullback independently by the usual pullback and inverse-image composition [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Bundle the explicitly prescribed derived-adjunction class [def-weil-pbc-abelian-higher-image-class] into an additive natural presheaf map kappa and define its unique sheafification lift. Define coefficient maps by the single, shifted-single and derived-direct-image functors. The augmentations, K-injectivity, additivity and naturality supporting these definitions are proved.

source.place: Tag 03Q8, label lemma-higher-direct-images, canonical associated-cohomology-presheaf construction. Agent expansion comparing its cocycle map with the explicitly constructed raw derived-adjunction evaluation.

proof.text: The augmentation is the inverse additive-functor single-complex comparison followed by the mapped resolution augmentation; exactness preserves its quasi-isomorphism. Etale restriction preserves injectives and a bounded-below complex of injectives is K-injective. Define the restricted K-injective resolution and compose its sections comparison with localization restriction, terminal evaluation and homology evaluation. Transport the homology presheaf through the specified component isomorphisms with the generic normalizationTransportPresheaf constructor; the identity and composition laws follow by cancelling adjacent inverse isomorphisms.

For kappa additivity and naturality, the existing constructed canonicalComparison has exactly the specified class formula. Take its sheafification-unit composite: additivity of components and naturality give the required properties. Define kappa from this named class function, and lift it through the sheafification hom-equivalence. All other maps are explicit composites.
